LUMENBOX SUPPORT KNOWLEDGE BASE

PRODUCT FACTS (Source: LumenBox Plans & Pricing page)
- Product: LumenBox Halo, a WiFi smart lamp with interchangeable "GlowPod" light+scent cartridges.
- Plans: Starter $14.99/mo (1 lamp, 1 GlowPod/mo, app control); Plus $24.99/mo (1 lamp, 2 GlowPods/mo, adaptive circadian scenes); Family $39.99/mo (2 lamps, 3 GlowPods/mo). Annual plans: pay 10 months, get 12.

DEVICE OWNERSHIP (Source: LumenBox Terms of Service Sec. 4)
- The lamp becomes the customer's property after 3 consecutive monthly payments.
- Cancelling before month 3 requires returning the lamp within 14 days in working condition, or a $49 device fee applies.

SHIPPING (Source: LumenBox Shipping Policy)
- GlowPods ship on the 1st of each month; the pause/skip cutoff is the 25th of the prior month.
- US shipping is free; international is a flat $6.99. Delivery: 3-7 business days domestic, 7-14 international.

REFUNDS & RETURNS (Source: LumenBox Returns & Refunds Policy)
- 30-day money-back guarantee on the first lamp purchase: full refund including first month; customer pays return shipping.
- Monthly GlowPod shipments are non-refundable once shipped, but can be paused/skipped anytime before the monthly cutoff.
- Damaged or defective items: free replacement within 14 days of delivery with photo proof, no return shipping needed.

CANCELLATION (Source: LumenBox Help Center - Manage your subscription)
- Cancel anytime via account portal or [REDACTED:EMAIL_ADDRESS]. No fee once past the month-3 ownership threshold (see device fee rule above if before month 3).

WARRANTY (Source: LumenBox Warranty Card, included with lamp)
- 1-year manufacturer warranty on lamp hardware, defects only - excludes misuse, water damage, drops.

SAFETY (Source: LumenBox Product Safety Notice / UL certification insert)
- Halo lamp is UL-listed, low-voltage (12V) LED. GlowPod cartridges are non-toxic but not for ingestion.
- Any smoke smell, overheating, sparking, or scorch marks: instruct the customer to unplug immediately. This is a safety issue, not a routine ticket.

TOP CUSTOMER QUESTIONS (Source: LumenBox Help Center FAQ index, by ticket volume)
1. How do I pause/skip a GlowPod shipment?
2. How do I change my GlowPod scent/color for next month?
3. My Halo lamp won't connect to WiFi.
4. My lamp won't turn on at all.
5. Can I change my billing date?
6. How does the referral program work? ($10 give / $10 get - Source: LumenBox Referral Program Terms)
7. How do I cancel my subscription?
8. What is your refund policy?
9. My GlowPod arrived damaged or leaking.
10. I smell burning or the lamp feels hot - what do I do?

POLICY THRESHOLDS FLAGGED FOR ESCALATION DOWNSTREAM (Source: LumenBox Escalation Matrix)
- Refund/credit requests over $75 total value.
- Any safety report (smoke, overheating, sparking, scorch marks, burns).
- Legal or regulatory threats (lawyer, lawsuit, BBB, CPSC).
- Requests to waive the $49 device fee or refund outside stated windows.
- 3rd+ contact from the same customer on an unresolved billing dispute.

ANYTHING_UNCLEAR
- No published data on GlowPod refill ingredient list/allergen disclosure - needed if allergy questions come in.
- No stated SLA for support response time; recommend one be set before macros promise a timeframe.
